name: Palmer Luckey
zh_summary: Despite being strongly pro-Ukraine/anti-Russian, criticizes Europeans and American left for complaining about America buying $1B in diesel fuel from Russia as out of touch, noting the EU has spent over $200B on Russian fuel and is on track for hundreds of billions more, mostly by wealthy members who can afford alternatives. References past German policies on nuclear and Nord Stream.
en_summary: Despite being strongly pro-Ukraine/anti-Russian, criticizes Europeans and American left for complaining about America buying $1B in diesel fuel from Russia as out of touch, noting the EU has spent over $200B on Russian fuel and is on track for hundreds of billions more, mostly by wealthy members who can afford alternatives. References past German policies on nuclear and Nord Stream.
text:
I hate qualifying arguments like this, but - everyone knows I am about as pro-Ukraine/anti-Russian as it gets.  That regularly leads to friction between me and other Republicans, even ones who otherwise align 99%.

With that said, whining from Europeans and the American left about America buying $1B in diesel fuel from Russia is so out of touch with reality.  The EU has spent over $200B on Russian fuel and is on-track to buy hundreds of billions more.  Most of that was purchased by wealthy EU members who can absolutely afford alternatives.

https://x.com/PalmerLuckey/status/2013068775495721285
